title: Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather
full_text:
[Theme: Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather - Vocal Composition]

[Intro]
[Acoustic harmonium & esraj melodic prelude for "Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather"]

[Pallavi]
Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather baje amar praane gopone shuni ekti madhur bhabona
Chondomoy e jiboner majhe shuni tomar chiroton sur
Hridoy aamar aaji bhora anonde geye jaye Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather
Akash jure royeche aalo alor majhe jege uthe mon

[Anupallavi]
Duti nayan mele dekhi tomar shundoro rupo rashi
Gobhir bhabe dake praan kon sudur theke bheshe asha bashi
Koto chaya koto maya ghonaye elo shondhar megh dole
Shokol dukkho bismrito hoye Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather sure mon jure roye

[Interlude]
[Esraj swara expansion & gentle tabla theka pacing]

[Charanam 1]
Aji probhate moner duwar khule dilam tomar lagi
Tomar ashay boshe achi chiro pother kinare eka
Mukto haway bheshe aashe tomar sneho bhora porosh
Je gaan shune jaglo nodi shei gane mor hriday horosh
Aapon mone geye choli Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather bhabonaye bhora gaan

[Reprise & Charanam 2]
Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather baje chiro kaal moner gobhire bhoriya shur
Jibon nodir kule kule bhese chole aamar ei kheya

[Outro]
[Soft tanpura resonance & gentle closing flute fade for "Aamar E Poth Tomar Pather"]

title: Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere
full_text:
[Theme: Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere - Vocal Composition]

[Intro]
[Braj classical tanpura & sarangi alaap for "Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere"]

[Pallavi]
Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere gaavat naina neer bhaye man mohan aagan me
Payoji maine ram ratan dhan payo vastu amolik de mere satguru
Prem nagariya basaayi man me har pal gavat Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere
Girdhar gopal prabhu araj suno meera ki aangan me

[Anupallavi]
Maayi ri maine liyo govindo mol koi kahe sasto koi kahe mehngo
Liyo ri maine amolak mol khelan aayi brij nagar me
Sadhu sang baith baith lok laaj khoi meera magan hui
Ghat ghat me biraje shyam sundar gavat Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere

[Interlude]
[Pakhawaj theka & sarangi sanchari ornamentation]

[Charanam 1]
Kharach na khoote chor na loote din din badhat sawaayo
Sat ki naav khevatiya satguru bhavsagar tar aayo
Charnamrit ras peevat nirmal man mohit bhayo re
Kabir das kahe sun bhai sadho sahaj samadhi bhalire
Rom rom me goonje re prabhu ji Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere

[Reprise & Charanam 2]
Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere ras barsat aangan me nirmal preeti bhalire
Meera ke prabhu girdhar nagar harakh harakh jas gaayo
Thumak chalat ram chandra baajat paijaniya
Surdas prabhu tumre darash bin chain nahi aavat naina
Tulsidas yahi araj karat hai charan kamal chit laave
Shri radha govind charan sharan paayi anand bhayo re

[Outro]
[Sarangi lingering bhairavi notes & tanpura fade for "Aao To Sahi Mohan Mere"]

title: Alarsara Parithapam
full_text:
[Theme: Alarsara Parithapam - Vocal Composition]

[Intro]
[Sopana sangeetham edakka & veena gentle introduction for "Alarsara Parithapam"]

[Pallavi]
Alarsara Parithapam ennum paadi manassil niranju nilkkum amrutham
Omanathinkal kidavo nalla komala thamara poovo en kannane
Bhavaye gopalam ananda roopam hridaya kamalathil Alarsara Parithapam
Swathi thirunal paadiya keerthanam pol nirmala sangeetham

[Anupallavi]
Poovil niranjo madhuvo paripoornnendu thante nilavo
Puthanaam rathna kanchiyil kanda muthundo muthin maniyo
Padmanabha padambujathil nithya sharanam thedi ethiyente
Alarsara parithapam neeki karunayegeethente Alarsara Parithapam

[Interlude]
[Edakka devotional rhythmic beat & veena swara sancharam]

[Charanam 1]
Kripaya paalaya shouray sakala loka nayakane thozhuvom
Mridula pada sparshathal bhoomi pulakam kondu thozhuthu
Gopa nandana gopika valla bha vanamaali neela varnna
Irayimman thampi aruliya thaalattu ketturangu en paithale
Ennum paadidam ee ganam manassinnullil Alarsara Parithapam

[Reprise & Charanam 2]
Alarsara Parithapam paadi thozhumbol mizhikalil aanandakkannuneer
Anantha shayanathil vaazhum sree padmanabha swamiyee

[Outro]
[Sopanam edakka slow finish & veena prayer chord for "Alarsara Parithapam"]

full_text:

[Intro]
[Chipli & Pakhawaj Marathi Bhakti Abhang intro for "Bhave Vina Bhakti"]

[Pallavi]
Bhave Vina Bhakti gajar kari bhakt daat pandhari chya vaatevari
Pandharichya vitevari ubha katevari haath thevuniya
Vitthal Vitthal naamaacha gajar kari man Bhave Vina Bhakti
Tulsichi maal gala peetambar jaritaari shobhe shrihari

[Anupallavi]
Bhet deyi bhaktaalaagi rakhumaaicha sundara shrihari
Majhe maher pandhari ahe bhimavari vithu raya re
Dnyaneshwar mauli tukaram jaya jaya ram krishna hari
Santanche charan dharoni gavu aamhi Bhave Vina Bhakti

[Interlude]
[Pakhawaj rhythmic jhala & harmonium theka expansion]

[Charanam 1]
Bhave vina bhakti naahi dev bhetat chitt shuddh karave
Vrikshavalli amha soyari vanachare pakshi susvare gaati
Sundar te dhyan ubhe vitevari kar kataavari thevoniya
Tulasi haar gala kase peetambar aavadte he roop manasi
Nama mhane vithu tuja darshane anand jhala Bhave Vina Bhakti

[Reprise & Charanam 2]

[Outro]
[Pakhawaj final devotional sam & chipli chime for "Bhave Vina Bhakti"]

[Dholak & rabab spiritual Punjabi sufi prelude for "Kirat Karam Ke Veechhde"]

[Sufi rabab drone & soft chiming dholak rhythm for "Kirat Karam Ke Veechhde"]

full_text:
[Theme: Aazhi Mazhai Kanna - Vocal Composition]

[Intro]
[Traditional tambura droning & veena alaapana for "Aazhi Mazhai Kanna"]

[Pallavi]
Aazhi Mazhai Kanna enum tirunaamam paadi panivom thiruvadiye
Aazhiyun pukku mukandhu kodaarttheri ezhundha arul naadam
Manathil aaraadha bhakti pongida paaduvom Aazhi Mazhai Kanna
Ellai illadha karunai vadivame thirumaal nithya thunaiye

[Anupallavi]
Sangu chakra dharane sarasiruhaksha karunamurthiyee
Thiruppavai nool uraitha kodhaiyin paamalai unakku arpanam
Veenaiyin naadham pol inikkum un thirunaama sangeetham
Ainthu pulanum unakkaga thudikkum koodalil Aazhi Mazhai Kanna

[Interlude]
[Nattuvangam jathi syllables & veena swara prastara]

[Charanam 1]
Aayarpadi maamayil meidhidum aayar kulak kozhundhe
Kuzhal oodhum kannan azhaginil mayangiye paaduvom
Kurai ondrum illadha maraimoorthi govinda paadaravindam
Neela mega vanna nithya ananda subham alikkum thaaye
Kaadhal thondrodu ninaindhu thozhuvom Aazhi Mazhai Kanna eppodhum

[Reprise & Charanam 2]
Aazhi Mazhai Kanna paadum idhayamengum aananda vellam perugum
Engum niraivaana paraman pugazhai eppozhudhum maraven

[Outro]
[Veena mangalam chord & mridangam final theermanam for "Aazhi Mazhai Kanna"]

title: Appa Rama Bhakti
full_text:
[Theme: Appa Rama Bhakti - Vocal Composition]

[Intro]
[Raga devotional tanpura & flute prelude for "Appa Rama Bhakti"]

[Pallavi]
Appa Rama Bhakti anedi parama pavana geethamu vinara manasa
Sarasija nayaniki sarva mangalamu nitya vibhavamunu
Bhavamu lona baagu matinchina amrutham Appa Rama Bhakti
Annamacharya keerthanala hariki nivedana chesedamu

[Anupallavi]
Endaro mahanubhavulu andariki vandanamu larpinchu
Ksheerabdhi kanyakaku sri mahalakshmikini jaya mangalam
Brahmam okkate parabrahmam okkate sarva bhoothalalo
Venkateshuni dayatho sakala sampadalu labhinche Appa Rama Bhakti

[Interlude]
[Flute gamaka phrasing & ghatam rhythmic sollukattu]

[Charanam 1]
Govinda naama smarana chesite kalugunu anantha punyambu
Namo narayana anedi ashtakshari mantramu hrudayapu deepamu
Alamelu manga sametha venkatapathi krupa varshamu kurise
Paluke bangaramayena kodandarama ninna choodaga manasu
Sangeetha sudharasamu olike Appa Rama Bhakti nitya gaanamu

[Reprise & Charanam 2]
Appa Rama Bhakti manasuna nilipi dhyaninchina mukti labhinchunu
Koti manmadha roopa sundara divya thejovilasane
Thyagaraja hrudaya nivasini sri rama chandra moorthi
Neerajalaya nitya vasini amrutha varshini sri laksmi
Sharanani vedina bhakthula paalita kalpatharuvu neevura
Mangalamu jaya mangalamu divya thirumala nayakuni ki

[Outro]
[Flute Madhyamavati mangalam refrain for "Appa Rama Bhakti"]
